d: In Washington, Rygaard goes deep into their roughest terrain yet in an attempt to recapture the title  in Alaska, Papac's dreams of a repeat are shattered when Coatsy's badly injured  in Canada, a new candidate steps into the ring.

In Alaska, the Papac team struggles to find someone to fill the shoes of injured Coatsy  Gabe Rygaard and his crew scramble to make up for their slow start  In Wyoming, David Zitterkopf and Sons keep their chainsaws humming.

In Alaska, Papac initiates an extremely dangerous process called Shotgun Logging  in Wyoming, the Zitterkopf men take the Bear Ranch site by storm  at Rygaard, the team doubles the yarders to increase production.

Shelby uses an airboat to search for century-old logs  Rygaard attempts to move a six-ton cypress  David's sons hold down the fort while he delivers a load of logs to the mill  the Dreadknots suffer a late-day accident.

Shelby tries to repair his custom-made buggy  David Zitterkopf makes a dangerous swing between trees  the Dreadknots go logging in the night  Triack is at a disadvantage when a crew member is injured.
Louisiana, Shelby and his assistant Bob go out looking for logs on his repaired swamp buggy  in Central Florida, the Chapman crew goes to fight against the legendary Gump log.

Shelby goes to Lake Pontchartrain with Belinda and Bob to obtain a huge log he marked years ago  in Florida, it's round two for the Chapman and Gump log  things go from bad to worse for the bare bones Rygaard crew.
The Rygaards go old school to keep the team on track  Shelby and Bob find a valuable sinker cypress  the Zitterkopf crew tries to take on a dangerous tangle of logs known as "the teepee of death."
